title: ISO/DIS 1328-4 — Gear flank tolerance classification — Part 4: Cylindrical worm gear tooth flank deviations
locator: Official draft scope and lifecycle: tolerance classification for individual cylindrical worm and worm wheel flanks; draft describes analytical and single-flank composite methods and explicitly excludes double-flank measurement
notes: Draft only; not a published International Standard and not to be cited as a normative requirement in a purchase specification unless the parties explicitly agree to a draft. The lifecycle/status must be rechecked before use. Full draft is not archived.
